reply_wording.NO_DQR: No DQR: this reply quotes passages only.
reply_wording.NO_PASSAGES: No passage in this use mode answers this question.
reply_wording.SERIES_HEADING: Series title (copied from the World Bank's list of series)
reply_wording.CLARIFY_LINE: This question is too vague to answer from the data. Pick one of these sharper questions:
reply_wording.NOT_BUILT: This question needs several steps planned in turn (route R6). That route is not built in this demonstrator.
reply_wording.DEMONSTRATOR_NOT_BUILT: Demonstrator note: a product would plan the steps itself, within a limit on steps, and show each one.
reply_wording.COMPARISON_LINE: People compare national accounts across economies to benchmark how each is doing. Check which measure is used and whether it is good enough for an international comparison.
reply_wording.EXPLANATION_HEADING: Explanation (written by a language model and checked against the figures above)
reply_wording.WITHHELD: The written explanation came from a language model and did not pass our quality checks, so it is not shown. Please contact our analyst if you want to know more.
reply_wording.DEMONSTRATOR_WITHHELD: Demonstrator note: this is a demonstration, not a product. A product would let you ask for the explanation to be refined, and would send your question to a named analyst. Here, no analyst receives it.
reply_wording.CORRECTED_HEADING: Corrected by the vertical domain expert
